Collins Aerospace is hiring a Software Engineer I to develop software for integrated sensor and signal processing products supporting intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. The role focuses on C++ and scripting development in Linux and contributes to aerospace and defense systems.
Aerospace

Responsibilities
Develop object-oriented C++ software solutions in a Linux environment
Put your understanding of the software development lifecycle to use
Write Python, MATLAB, and/or similar scripting/programming languages in a Linux software development environment
Work independently and in a small team environment

Required
The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date
Experience and/or knowledge in programming multithreaded systems
Experience in software development using C++
Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects
Preferred
Experience with the Qt software development framework
Experience with web development technologies/toolkits such as JavaScript (Node.js, D3.js), PHP, HTML5, CSS, Angular, or Google Web Toolkit (GWT)
Experience with digital signal processing and/or communication systems
Familiarity with debugging software in embedded computing environments
Familiarity with using version control and defect tracking tools (Git, JIRA, etc.)
Familiarity with Agile/SCRUM, DevOps, and test automation practices
Knowledge of network and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP)
Benefits
Hired applicants may be eligible for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability.
Hired applicants may be eligible for a 401(k) match and flexible spending accounts.
Hired applicants may be eligible for flexible work schedules.
Hired applicants may be eligible for the employee assistance program and Employee Scholar Program.
Hired applicants may be eligible for parental leave, paid time off, and holidays.
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs, depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments are not guaranteed and depend on factors including individual, business unit, and/or company performance.
